note: Reference catalog example only. Values are never stored here. Resolution is read-only and requires a runtime-authorized secret store that I01 deliberately does not implement; every ref stays NOT_PROVISIONED until such a store exists.

refs.purpose: read-only fetch of pinned upstream sources for the controller runner
single fixed Comet authority identity for the runner; no copied state and no concurrent second writer
author worker's model API credential; per-worker binding, never shared with controller or reviewer identities
reviewer worker's model API credential; per-worker binding, independent from author and controller identities
runner's read-only access to the pinned controlled Comet source and project patches in its workspace mount
publisher-side grant for Outline content issuance; never resolvable by ordinary agent identities
isolator-side grant for Outline isolation and revocation paths
OIDC client credential identifying the Outline instance to the identity provider
dedicated Outline Postgres credential; new project resource, never shared across projects
dedicated Outline Redis credential; cache only, never the rights authority
Outline app session credential (session/cookie signing) for the dedicated pilot instance; values stay out of Git and reports
dedicated object store credential for Outline attachments and signed URL issuance
code knowledge provider credential; source read access does not imply outbound publish rights
container registry credential for CI image delivery
monitoring and alerting delivery credential; observations only, no control-plane writes
backup encryption key reference; secret backups stay separate from data backups and restoration stops if the key is unavailable
